change_summary.cost_impact: Software patch only; OTA update possible
change_summary.description: SOA debounce counter not reset on voltage recovery; causes false fault after transients
change_summary.safety_impact: Nuisance contactor openings; driver distraction; reduced availability

decision.rationale: Defect in state machine: DEBOUNCING -> IDLE transition missing counter reset. Add explicit reset action. Add test case for transient recovery.

affected_artifacts: FB2-SW-DSN-000002 (SOA design - state machine missing transition)
FB2-SW-SWR-000002 (SWR - missing requirement for counter reset)
impact_analysis.risk_assessment: Transient voltage noise (e.g., contactor switching) causes debounce counter to accumulate; subsequent normal operation triggers false fault after 2 transients. Vehicle experiences nuisance contactor openings.

required_updates: Add DEBOUNCING -> IDLE transition with counter reset in SOA design
Add requirement: 'Debounce counter shall reset when voltage returns within limits'
Add test case: transient overvoltage followed by recovery -> no fault
reverification_selection: FB2-VER-TMS-000001 (updated with transient recovery test case)
New test: 3 transients of 4300mV for 50ms each, separated by 200ms normal -> no fault
